prompt: In some cities public parks and open spaces are being changed into gardens where local residents can grow their fruit and vegetable. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
The transformation of public parks and open spaces into gardens where local residents can plant fruit and vegetables is a popular topic of discussion . Some people think it has advantages, while others  believe it has disadvantages. In this essay, I believe that the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.

There are several advantages of planting fruit and vegetables. Firstly, this helps to encourage people to eat healthy food. For example, people will cook food from their gardens instead of eating other food which may cause diseases. As a result, eating clean food can improve public health and reduce hospital visits. Another advantage is that people  can spend less money at supermarkets.

For instance, shopping requires people  to spend more money, and the price of fruit and vegetable are higher in some countries, such as South Korea. Therefore, helps to reduce pollution and make people care more about the environment.

On the other hand, there are also disadvantages of gardens where local residents can grow fruit and vegetables. One major disadvantage is that people may ignore local stores, which can cause business owners to lose their businesses. For example, if all individuals have their own gardens, business owners may lose their jobs because nobody will buy their fruit and vegetables. As a result, this may have a negative  impact on the economy. Another disadvantage is the reduction of public parks around the city, which makes it difficult for people to enjoy nature. For example, some families have many children and need a place to enjoy their time and do some activities. Therefore, increasing the need for people to have their own parks may cause problems for governments.

In conclusion, I believe that the advantages outweigh the disadvantages because they improve people’s health and save money
